expectations.text: Avoids commodity language and vendor positioning
expectations.evidence: Uses commodity language: 'Photorealistic Renders', 'High-impact imagery'; lists deliverables as primary content; no strategic positioning present; could apply to any visualization studio.

expectations.text: Connects to business outcome (sales, decisions, risk, alignment)
expectations.evidence: Mentions 'Accelerate project approval and investor confidence' in opening but doesn't follow through; becomes deliverable list; no connection between visualization and investor decision logic; outcome mentioned but not developed.

expectations.text: Positions Rendimension as strategic partner, not vendor
expectations.evidence: Positions as visualization vendor providing deliverables; offers three 'options' for slide layout, none of which reframes the positioning; entire approach is vendor-style proposal structure.

All three options lead with deliverables ('8 Photorealistic Renders', 'Interactive Virtual Tour', 'Professional Floor Plan'); never develops outcome-first logic; structure remains deliverable-list format.

expectations.text: Would pass Hugo's review without edits
expectations.evidence: Would not pass; reads as standard visualization proposal; uses 'photorealistic' and quality language; doesn't establish strategic authority; presentation format is vendor-style, not partnership-style.
